name: Utah

rule.phaseIn: Until Dec. 31, 2026 only PWC operators aged 12-17 need a course. From Jan. 1, 2027 every operator of a motorboat or sailboat must also complete a short state watercraft operator safety course each calendar year and carry proof.
rule.textEn: Today only PWC riders aged 12 to 17 need an approved boating safety course. From Jan. 1, 2027 everyone who runs a motorboat or sailboat must also take a short state safety course once every calendar year.
rule.textEs: Hoy solo los conductores de motos acuáticas de 12 a 17 años necesitan un curso de seguridad náutica aprobado. Desde el 1 de enero de 2027, toda persona que maneje una lancha o un velero deberá además hacer un breve curso estatal de seguridad una vez por año calendario.

minAge.note: Under 16: motorboat only with a person 18+ on board supervising. PWC from 12 with the course; ages 12-15 also need direct supervision by someone 18+.

exemptions: PWC course: operators 18 and older (until the 2027 annual course applies to all motorboat and sailboat operators).
From 2027: renters may get a livery safety briefing instead of the annual course.

card.nameEn: Boating safety certificate (PWC youth course); from 2027 also proof of the annual watercraft operator safety course
card.feeNote: The law lets the division charge a fee for its boating safety course; amount not stated in the statute.
card.validity: Annual course (2027+): proof expires at the end of the calendar year

rental: From 2027 a livery may rent only to someone with proof of the annual course or after giving a state safety briefing.
pwcExtra: PWC riders 12-15 need the course plus direct (visual) supervision by someone 18+; 16-17 need the course only.

sources.quote: A person who is at least 12 years of age or older but under 16 years of age may operate a personal watercraft provided he:
A person who is at least 16 years of age but under 18 years of age may operate a personal watercraft, if the person: (a) completes a boating safety course approved by the division
A person under 16 years of age may not operate a motorboat on the waters of this state unless the person is under the on-board and direct supervision of a person who is at least 18 years of age.
The division may collect fees set by the division in accordance with Section 63J-1-504 from each person who takes the division's boating safety course
A violation of this section is an infraction.
A watercraft operator shall complete the course once every calendar year.
The proof of completion expires the day after December 31 in the calendar year which the operator completes the watercraft operator safety course.

sources.publisher: Utah State Legislature, H.B. 54 (2026 General Session), enrolled copy
sources.quote: This bill takes effect on January 1, 2027.
